This changelog fragment file name will fail the changelog workflow. CI enforces fragments to be named `<PR_NUMBER>.<type>` (type: added/changed/deprecated/removed/fixed) and to match the current PR number; `+tool-span-internal-kind.fixed` does not match the required pattern.

Rename this fragment to `util/opentelemetry-util-genai/.changelog/<PR_NUMBER>.fixed` (and keep the same one-line contents).

+Emit ``execute_tool`` spans with ``INTERNAL`` span kind instead of ``CLIENT``.

threads.body: `expected_kinds` is a set, but `sort()` is intended for arrays. To avoid Rego type issues (and make the message deterministic across OPA versions), convert the set to an array before sorting.
